question: Which improper bodily postures during the rite are being identified?
premises: Bodily posture during the rite matters
Feet may be raised on the seat
Feet may rest on knees or calves
inference: Sitting with feet raised on the seat, or on the knees, or on the calves is identified as a posture in question
plain_english: One may be seated with feet raised on the seat, or placed on the knees, or likewise on the calves.
